field_corrections: model_filed: null -> true on engagement 1, engagement 3, dose 1, efficacy 1 (cyno-monkey-hpg): FDA 214846 PharmR p.32 summarises study TAK-385-00095, single oral 0.1-3 mg/kg in nine castrated cynomolgus monkeys, LH suppressed to 48 h at 3 mg/kg.

Context note: 'barely rat GnRHR' is true of relugolix (rat IC50 2900 nM, FDA PharmR p.3) but not linzagolix, which suppressed LH in male rats and E2 in pro-oestrus female rats (EPAR p.18) and worked in the rat endometriosis model.

missing: Patient-derived xenograft ('murine avatar') of human endometrioma lesions in NOD/SCID mice dosed with the GnRH antagonist cetrorelix: low-PR lesions respond more to GnRH antagonism than to MPA (F S Sci 2025, PMID 39393571, doi 10.1016/j.xfss.2024.10.004). A patient-level track for this mechanism with a non-member peptide sibling (product_in_model false, modality outside the tile); no patient comparison yet, so untested, but it is a model compared-in-principle with patients and should be listed.

Rat autotransplant track has no dose entry although Tezuka 2023 (PMID 37186405) states a model exposure target: 'The effective concentration of linzagolix, calculated as the free form of the last-observed drug concentration, was ~1 umol/L in endometriosis model rats.' Comparable to human free exposure at 200 mg (EPAR gives ~3-fold free-drug margin); at least an untested opening entry, possibly same.

Knock-in mouse reversibility prediction (Nakata 2014: gonadal function recovered within 14 days of withdrawal) matched by faster menses return on relugolix vs leuprorelin (Osuga 2022, PMID 34895700). A held prediction on the hgnrhr-knockin-mouse track; does not lift the bone contra but belongs in the record.

Nothing missed on failures: no endometriosis press-release or EMA failure for relugolix or linzagolix (EDELWEISS 2 termination already noted); opigolix/ASP1707 has no preclinical model on PubMed or Europe PMC (16 hits, all clinical or reviews), confirming the drafter's 'no public model'.

Dating source for linzagolix patient BMD and E2: ObsEva phase 2b EDELWEISS final-results release, 2018-09-28 (globenewswire 1586251), lumbar spine BMD -0.80% (75 mg) to -2.60% (200 mg) at 24 weeks; predates Donnez 2020 and should date safety entries on linzagolix BMD.
rule_questions: Efficacy from PD-only models: can a model with no disease readout (knock-in mouse uterine weight; monkey E2/menses) score efficacy against a pain primary endpoint, or is that scoring the oestrogen-deprivation hypothesis rather than the model? The draft scores the mouse same and the monkey untested on identical evidence; the rules decide neither.

Insensitive null as a prediction: the mouse measured bone density and found no change, but its OVX positive control also showed none (4 weeks). Is that a stated prediction of no harm (contra when patients lost BMD) or an inadmissible comparison (untested)?

Decision 16 gap: the model stated an absolute liver margin <1 at the clinical exposure (EPAR), yet patients were dosed to 200 mg with only slight LFT excess. Is dose same with source_calls_it partial/over_predicted, or contra with magnitude opposite for a misplaced margin in the conservative direction?

Retrodiction with an unknown run date: the linzagolix rat study is in the MAA primary-PD package (EPAR 2022) and was published in 2023, after the 2018 phase 2b readout; its run date is not public. Default prospective (same) or retro?

Must every track open in every cell? The rat track appears only in efficacy and the tox track only in dose/safety; lint accepts this, the brief's 'each cell opens at model_first_use_year' is ambiguous.
Which area spelling is canonical: tiles.json 'endocrine' or the contexts' capitalised 'Endocrine'?

Co-primary call when sponsor and paper differ: ObsEva's topline release says 75 mg 'did not meet the co-primary efficacy objective'; Donnez 2024 (tier 1) says only that 200 mg 'met the primary efficacy objective'. Does the sponsor's explicit failure call make efficacy 7 contra, or does the higher-tier paper's silence keep partial?
drug for a system dosed only with a non-member sibling (PDX avatar, cetrorelix): is 'class' right, given the brief reserves 'class' for systems tied to no drug?
Proxy safety claim on a member track: can SKI2670's 'without bone loss' (a non-member) be scored contra against linzagolix patients under the drug-specific safety rule?
